description: Prepare and stage a server file (e.g. CSV report, JSON snapshot, or ZIP archive) for direct browser download without opening a new window.
command:
python3 -c '
import sys, os, shutil, json

raw_file = sys.argv[1].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""

quote_chars = chr(34) + chr(39)
target = raw_file.strip(quote_chars)
if not target:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "No file specified to download", "status": "failed"}))
    sys.exit(1)

candidates = [
    target,
    os.path.join(".", target),
    os.path.join("snapshots", target),
    os.path.join("static", "downloads", target),
    os.path.join("../runningly-chat-web/static/downloads", target),
    os.path.basename(target)
]

found_file = None
for c in candidates:
    if os.path.isfile(c):
        found_file = os.path.abspath(c)
        break

if not found_file:
    print(json.dumps({"error": f"File not found on server: {target}", "status": "not_found"}))
    sys.exit(1)

filename = os.path.basename(found_file)
size_bytes = os.path.getsize(found_file)
size_kb = round(size_bytes / 1024, 2)

# Stage file to static downloads directories for web server
for d in ["static/downloads", "../runningly-chat-web/static/downloads"]:
    try:
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
        dest = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(d, filename))
        if found_file != dest:
            shutil.copy2(found_file, dest)
    except Exception:
        pass

download_url = f"/download?file={filename}"

print(f"File ready for direct download:")
print(f"  • Filename: {filename}")
print(f"  • Size: {size_kb} KB ({size_bytes} bytes)")
print(f"  • Server Path: {found_file}")
print(f"  • Download Link: {download_url}")

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "ready",
    "file_name": filename,
    "file_path": found_file,
    "download_file": filename,
    "download_url": download_url,
    "file_size_kb": size_kb
}))
' "${answer1}"
questions: What is the server file path or name to download? (e.g. 'users_difference_report.csv', 'final.zip', or snapshot tag/file)*
